keyFindings.description: findKnees walks failed rows as ordinary series steps: a sampler gap, restart or missing summary becomes 'Knee at Nx', refineFactors spends refinement steps on that bracket, and a real load knee directly after a failed row is never reported (its predecessor did not pass). Contradicts the PR body's 'the curves take no number from it' and plan D5 'keeps it out of the curves'.

A failed copy-back is only noted, never record_failure'd: a step whose heap.txt or partial tar stream failed is counted as complete, and a truncated summary.json makes curves/tables fail for the whole run. The PR body says a failed copy-back marks the step failed.

cmd__sampler never stops on its own: after a killed run (round-1 failure 2's case) or a down from another pod, eight role loops keep kubectl exec streams or append an error line every 5 s to cgroup.jsonl on the holder pod for ever. Same class as the heartbeat defect fixed this round.

A run kept with all --keep (documented as staying up for the caller's typing steps and replays) stops renewing its lock 60 s after its last command; after 15 idle minutes any other up calls it stale and hands out the down that destroys it, with no word to check the holder's issue first. Neither the --keep header nor README says so.

Liveness files hold bare pids (commands/<pid>, heartbeat.pid, sampler.pid). A second Legion role in the pod (another PID namespace, same $TMPDIR root) driving the same run is seen as dead: its command files are deleted, ensure_daemons starts a second heartbeat and a second sampler appending to the same cgroup.jsonl. use_run should refuse a run made in another PID namespace.

Step kind is guessed from the name suffix (-hour, -db4, -reads): a caller step after db-size 4 not named -db4 enters the 16 vCPU knee series. Classify from what run_step knows (phase, Postgres CPU in copy-meta).
